extracted.intended_audience: journalists and editors of ethnic/minority media; media researchers, students, and policy makers interested in ethnic media news values
extracted.subtask_description: A compact rubric describing newsworthiness criteria and functional roles specific to media serving ethnic, racial, or immigrant communities (ethnic/minority media). Useful for evaluating story selection, production priorities, and organizational character of such outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of ethnic media
rubrics_metrics.description: "Media by and for ethnics in a host country with content in ethnic languages" (Yu Shi).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both large outlets and small organic community publications; emphasizes media produced for specific ethnic/linguistic communities within a host country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve community information needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: provide information that addresses the specific informational needs of the ethnic community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timely, practical, and culturally-relevant information that the community depends on for daily life and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bridge community to host society
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: act as an intermediary connecting the ethnic community with the broader host society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes translations, explanations of host-country institutions/policies, and framing that helps community members navigate civic life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counter mainstream invisibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: counteract the group's invisibility or marginalization in mainstream media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes stories that make the community visible and that would otherwise be ignored or underreported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve cultural identity / language
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: support cultural continuity and language maintenance within the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers cultural programming, language-specific reporting, and content that reinforces traditions and heritage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connect diaspora to homeland
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: maintain links between diaspora communities and their countries/regions of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes homeland news, transnational politics, migration updates, and issues affecting relatives abroad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocate for community interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: advance or defend the political, social, and economic interests of the ethnic community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include advocacy journalism, coverage of rights/anti-discrimination issues, and highlighting community leaders and initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make community visible to civic leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Function: ensure civic leaders and institutions are aware of community needs and presence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story selection can prioritize topics that influence policymaking or resource allocation for the community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-centered newsworthiness
rubrics_metrics.description: A value that privileges stories about the community's internal life: community success stories, cultural events, religious news, immigration policy developments, discrimination/rights issues, and community organizations' activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: profiles of entrepreneurs/students/leaders; coverage of festivals and observances; reporting on local faith communities and organizational work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Homeland connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsworthiness that emphasizes diaspora-relevant homeland news, transnational politics, migration stories, and remittance/family ties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes items that link local community experiences to developments in the homeland or transnational networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service / practical value
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical, utility-focused reporting such as visa/immigration information, tax/legal guidance in the ethnic language, business/commercial news in the ethnic economy, health resources in language, and education information for immigrant families.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes actionable, how-to, and resource-oriented content that directly assists immigrants in navigating host-society systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identity issues reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focused on generational tensions, hybrid identity stories, religious/cultural debates, and language preservation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights intra-community debates and identity formation across generations as salient beats for ethnic media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Individual place of origin
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: the individual place of origin of the community served.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to analyze how origin shapes content, audience interests, and connections to homeland issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Historical evolution
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: the historical evolution of the ethnic media outlet or community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers how the media's history informs present functions and editorial priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Production process
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: how content is produced (who produces it, with what resources, and with what practices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes personnel, language choices, editorial workflows, and community involvement in production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Distribution pattern
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: the patterns by which the media is distributed to its audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examines circulation, distribution channels (print, broadcast, online, community venues), and reach within diaspora networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: who owns the outlet and what that implies for content and orientation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between community-owned, commercial, ethnic-entrepreneurial, and transnational ownership structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Self-identity of outlet
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: the outlet's self-identity (non-profit vs for-profit; alternative vs commercial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Self-definition shapes editorial missions, resource allocation, and the balance between service and advocacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yu Shi — Connection to power groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of Yu Shi's 7-pronged test: ties to local and transnational power groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers relationships with political elites, homeland institutions, community organizations, and transnational networks that influence editorial stance and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community impact (implicit newsworthiness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: the extent to which a story affects or matters to the community is heavily weighted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that have clear, tangible impact on community members' lives are prioritized over abstract or distant topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filling mainstream coverage gaps
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: ethnic media prioritize topics under-covered or ignored by mainstream outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes beat areas where mainstream media lack linguistic, cultural, or contextual competence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language access
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: providing information in the community's language(s) is a core value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Language access includes translation, bilingual reporting, and producing original content in heritage languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural specificity
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: culturally specific angles and frames are privileged over generic framings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should reflect cultural practices, norms, and values of the community rather than applying only mainstream cultural frames.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counter-narrative to stereotypes
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: content that challenges mainstream stereotypes and offers corrective representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists may foreground stories that complicate or rebut simplistic portrayals in dominant media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical utility for immigrants
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: usefulness in helping immigrants solve everyday problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on information that helps navigate immigration, legal, health, education, and economic systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: relevance across borders, reflecting transnational ties and flows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes remittances, migration chains, homeland political developments, and family ties spanning countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretive context for host-society events
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: providing explanation and interpretation of host-society events from the community's perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps readers understand how broader civic/political developments affect their community specifically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identity affirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: content that affirms group identity and belonging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes celebratory coverage, cultural education, and narratives that strengthen communal cohesion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic participation enabling
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit criterion: reporting that enables or encourages civic engagement and participation by community members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: voter information, civic rights education, and coverage that mobilizes community action.
